% ICLR single-column convergence figure; requires graphicx.
% Generated by scripts/plot_convergence_curve.py from results.csv.
\begin{figure}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{analysis/paper/convergence_curve/fig_convergence_curve.pdf}
  \caption{\textbf{HT learns effective robot policies faster than Flow and MSE.}
  We report mean success across 24 RoboCasa-GR1 tasks, with 20 evaluation
  episodes per task. All methods fine-tune the same GR00T N1.7 model using
  the same data and training schedule; only the objective differs. HT reaches
  43.0\% success at 32k steps, approaching Flow's 44.1\% result at 60k. At
  60k steps, HT obtains 51.5\%, compared with 44.1\% for Flow and 37.8\% for
  MSE. The available HT checkpoints at 2k--32k use $\nu=2$, while the reported
  60k model uses the paper setting $\nu=4d$. Markers denote measured
  evaluations, and lines only connect the displayed checkpoints.}
  \label{fig:convergence-curve}
\end{figure}
